meta.task: P6 per-map placement calibration of in-game minimap frames

frame_index_rule.rule: client_index = server_value - 1; if client_index >= 1000 -> FMMap.wil frame = client_index - 1000 (= value - 1001); else MMap.wil frame = client_index (= value - 1)

exe_evidence.note: network map-change handler: word field at [esp+0x16] read, AND 0xffff, then dec (0x420c3a) before calling the minimap setter 0x43d780
setter stores index at [this+0x28c]; cmp eax,0x3e8 (1000); jl -> MMap branch; >= 1000 -> add eax,0xfffffc18 (-1000) and select frame in library at [this+0x148] (FMMap.wil)
MMap branch: selects frame in library at [this+4] (MMap.wil)
ctor loads MMap.wil ('\Data\MMap.wil' VA 0x47c428) into [this+4], FMMap.wil (VA 0x47c414) into [this+0x148]

frame_index_rule.consequence: The EI client renders MMap.wil frame value-1, not frame value. Existing crossref/simulator rule (frame=value for value<1001) is off by one for every MMap.wil map; FMMap rule (value-1001) is correct.
frame_index_rule.geometric_confirmation: with frame=value-1, 229/241 maps with readable headers match frame_size==ceil4(W*1.5)xH; with frame=value only 160/241 match.

placement_formula.origin: (0,0) top-left of frame canvas; no per-map offset

exe_evidence.note: after frame select, frame header width/height (movsx word [eax] / [eax+2]) set into frame rect [this+0x2e0] via SetRect-like call [0x4762b0]
player marker X: fild [this+0x2f8] * float[0x476904] = *1.5 -> frame canvas px
object markers (0x5600a0 list): fild [ent+4] * float[0x476904] = *1.5; Y (ent+8) has no multiplier (x1.0)

placement_formula.asset_confirmation: 229/241 readable-header entries have frame_w==ceil4(W*1.5) and frame_h==H; painted bbox == full frame (minx=miny=0, fill=1.0) for every used frame; WIL offsetX/offsetY (-24,-16) is constant and does not shift painted content.

exceptions.note: FMMap frame 30 header is 452x300 with offset (0,0); painted bbox 450x300 == exact W*1.5 (300-tile map); the +2px width is canvas padding

exe_evidence.note: update recomputes dest rect anchored to screen right edge: SetRect(&[this+0x2c0], 800-min(panel_w,frame_w), 0, 800, min(panel_h,frame_h))

panel_geometry.render_note: client draws the full frame canvas scaled into the 128x128 panel; source window [this+0x2d0] tracks the player; the simulator's ~128px panel with object-fit:cover is a faithful approximation.

anomalies.note: FMMap frames 31-37 do not exist (FMMap.wil has 31 frames 0..30); maps 401-405/407 point there -> no overland minimap in this client build.

verdict.summary: Minimap placement is fully determined: per-map origin (0,0), uniform scale 1.5px/tile X and 1.0px/tile Y, frame size ceil4(W*1.5) x H, drawn into a 128x128 panel at screen (672,0)-(800,128). The P6 'blank margins / per-map painted sub-rectangle' premise is FALSE for MMap/FMMap frames: every used frame is painted full-canvas with top-left origin. The real P6 defect is an off-by-one frame index: the client uses MMap frame value-1 while the current simulator/crossref uses frame value, so every MMap.wil map renders the wrong minimap image (same size block, adjacent frame). FMMap mapping (value-1001) is correct. 12 maps point at genuinely blank frames (no artwork) and 72 server-only maps are absent from the EI client Map dir.
verdict.remaining: None blocking. If desired, visually confirm MMap frame 0 == 比奇矿区-type dungeon for D001 (value 1) in the simulator after fixing the index rule.
